name: gizza-ai/pdf-to-epub
summary: Convert a text-based PDF into a reflowable EPUB ebook.

tool.description: Convert a text-based PDF into a reflowable EPUB ebook (one chapter per page, with a table of contents). Wrapped lines are unwrapped into flowing text so the result reflows on any reader; set preserve_line_breaks to keep the original line layout (e.g. for poetry or code). Provide the PDF as url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call, and optionally a title and author for the ebook metadata. Returns the EPUB file as a download. Extracts the embedded text layer only — it does not OCR scanned/image-only PDFs (those produce empty chapters).

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

title.description: Book title for the EPUB metadata (dc:title). Defaults to "Untitled" if omitted.

author.description: Optional author for the EPUB metadata (dc:creator).

preserve_line_breaks.description: When true, keep the PDF's hard line breaks as line breaks. When false (default), wrapped lines are merged into flowing text for clean reflow. Default false.
